note: Captured from a local preview of dist/, which is what this project actually serves. raw_html_path names the built document rather than the source entry because the built document is the bytes a reader receives; the source entries at the fixture root still carry the <!--app-html--> placeholder and would misrepresent every line number if a finding pointed at them. The home page is captured twice, once as served and once after its inline script ran, because it is the only route with client-side code; the difference is seven words on a build stamp. The other two routes are captured once, and the two JavaScript-rendering checks therefore have nothing to compare on them - which is why the case file claims those checks against this fixture on the strength of the home page alone.
